prompt:
bench: the plan, tools/ and card do not exist here; everything is below; return only the draft path.

You are the phase planner for the shelf project. This directory is the project: `GENERATION_PLAN.md` (generation 1, twelve phases), `PROJECT_CONTEXT.md`, `HOW_WE_WORK.md`, `PHASE_SEED.md` (the phase-plan template and its task-line grammar), `shelf/` the package and `tests/` its suite. There is no `phase-ends/` and no plan tool; read the files directly.

Draft the phase plan for phase 1.11 (Overdue notices) and write it to `.run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`. The draft's Milestone line carries phase 1.11's milestone clauses; every clause must be covered by some task whose `done-when:` or `verify:` names what the clause names; every task line has `files:` and a runnable `verify:`. Do not write any other file and do not start the work.

Return only one line: `DRAFT: .run/PHASE_PLAN.draft.md`.

milestone.clause: `overdue_notices` returns one notice per member with overdue loans, listing each title, days late and fee (verified by: `python -m unittest tests.test_overdue_notices`)
`notice_text` renders a notice as plain text no wider than 72 columns, with the total owed on the last line
the whole suite stays green (verified by: `python -m unittest discover -s tests`)

rubric_items: `overdue_notices` returns one notice per member with overdue loans, listing title, days late and fee (tests/test_overdue_notices.py).
Fees come from fees.loan_fee_cents with the member's kind; titles come from the catalog.

The `notice_text` clause has no check in the generation plan; the draft gives it a machine check, a named test (for example tests/test_notice_text.py) in a task's verify and on the Milestone line, or raises it; it never leaves the clause unchecked.
notice_text lines are at most 72 columns and the last line carries the total owed, formatted by format_cents.
Every clause on the draft's Milestone line has a verified-by check.
Tasks touch only shelf/ and tests/.
The last task or the milestone check runs `python -m unittest discover -s tests`.
